::: proof

For entry $(i,j)$, where row $i$ indexes the denominator $\vb$
(see @def-vector-valued-derivative)
and column $j$ indexes the numerator $\matr{A}\vb$:

$$
\ba
\left[\deriv{\vb} (\matr{A}\vb)\right]_{ij}
&= \deriv{\beta_i} (\matr{A}\vb)_j \\
&= \deriv{\beta_i} \sum_{k=1}^{p} a_{jk} \beta_k \\
&= a_{ji} \\
&= \left[\tp{\matr{A}}\right]_{ij}
\ea
$$

:::
